findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_anomalies, get_polymarket_new_wallets, get_apex_signals, get_satoshi_moves · Private data: get_anomalies, verify_memecoin, get_polymarket_whales, get_polymarket_new_wallets, get_polymarket_market_stats, get_btc_snapshot, get_launch_ta_confluence, get_satoshi_moves · Public sink: get_polymarket_market_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_anomalies, get_polymarket_new_wallets, get_apex_signals, get_satoshi_moves · Private data: get_anomalies, verify_memecoin, get_polymarket_whales, get_polymarket_new_wallets, get_polymarket_market_stats, get_btc_snapshot, get_launch_ta_confluence, get_satoshi_moves · Public sink: get_polymarket_market_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
